upstream_fix_review.details: Right: levlnbr < 1 now rejected by archTleafArchLoad() (arch_tleaf.c:115-116) and SCOTCH_archTleaf() (library_arch.c:552-555) ('tleaf 0', 'sub 1 0 tleaf 0' now 'bad input (1)', no report); sizes/links validated in SCOTCH_archTleaf(); ltleaf duplicate and level-boundary checks no longer debug-only; SCOTCH_archLtleaf() checks index range and duplicates. Wrong: (1) the new memFree (archptr->sizetab) on 'bad input (2)' and 'invalid architecture size' (arch_tleaf.c:135,143) and on the ltleaf 'fail:' label (arch_tleaf.c:699-700) leave the freed pointer in the body, and archLoad() then calls archTleafArchFree() (arch_tleaf.c:172) which frees it again: 'tleaf 2 4 1 x' -> 'AddressSanitizer: attempting double-free ... #1 _SCOTCHarchTleafArchFree arch_tleaf.c:172 #2 _SCOTCHarchLoad arch.c:216; freed by _SCOTCHarchTleafArchLoad arch_tleaf.c:135' (clean in 7.0.17), same for 'ltleaf 2 4 1 2 1 8 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 x' (freed at arch_tleaf.c:700); (2) the overflow test '(archsiz * sizetab[levlnum]) < archsiz' (arch_tleaf.c:141, library_arch.c:581) computes the signed product it guards (UBSan 'signed integer overflow') and misses wraps to a larger value: 'tleaf 2 100000 1 50000 1' loads with size=705032704 on 32-bit; (3) SCOTCH_archTleaf()/SCOTCH_archLtleaf() free their arrays on error but leave them, and the class, in the Arch, so the caller's SCOTCH_archExit() frees them again: archbuild 0 (perm {5,0}) and 1 (duplicate) -> 'attempting double-free ... archTleafArchFree arch_tleaf.c:174; freed by SCOTCH_archLtleaf library_arch.c:630', archbuild 4 (sizes {0,-3}) -> heap-use-after-free; (4) the now-unconditional level-boundary loop (arch_tleaf.c:708-714) multiplies by sizetab[levlnum] after decrementing and before testing levlnum < 0, reading sizetab[-1]: 'ltleaf 1 4 1 3 2 1 0' -> 'heap-buffer-overflow ... _SCOTCHarchLtleafArchLoad arch_tleaf.c:709'; (5) SCOTCH_archLtleaf() still accepts permnbr < 1 and permutation sizes that do not match a level boundary (archbuild 2: permnbr 3 on size 4 -> r=0).
upstream_fix_review.compared_with_ours: Our 7.0.17 0002 moved every check into new archTleafArchBuild()/archLtleafArchBuild() routines shared by loaders and builders (327 lines), with ANUMMAX-division overflow checks and fields published on success. He chose inline checks in each loader/builder instead; ours had none of the five defects above, his avoided a refactor. Rebased series keeps his inline structure and fixes only the defects (0002-0005), which is smaller and fits his choice; our test addition (ltleaf in test_scotch_arch.c) is not carried, as it would conflict with G01's ARCHNBR change (see SUMMARY).

review_accuracy: Accurate on mechanism and fix. Its exact string 'ltleaf 1 4 1 4 0 0 1 2' gives an uninitialised peritab slot, which reads out of bounds at line 801 only when the garbage value makes the modulo negative (seen through SCOTCH_archLtleaf under ASan, not through gmap, where the symptom is a lost terminal); the mismatched-size variant is the one that crashes deterministically (line 497).
first_pass_critique: Status, evidence and the sizetab[-1] reading are right. Its preferred option A (loader-only, O(n) marking) is correct for files but leaves SCOTCH_archLtleaf with the same holes (it addressed those separately in API-10 by duplicating the checks in library_arch.c, i.e. two copies of the same validation, which is not what the tree does for cmpltw/sub). Its diff keeps `peritab[...] = -1` sentinels instead of the tree's ~0 idiom, and does not make archTleafArchFree tolerate a half-built body.
